rulings.title: Per-owner authority action and source fact contracts
rulings.body: Adopt authority-event-contracts.md WA-R068 matrix as the semantic action registration and owner-specific facts contract. Role owns interpretation, Identity assurance, source owners facts/lifecycle. B/S/A obligations distinguish ordinary authority, fresh action-bound assurance and durable sensitive-access proof. Explicit operator actions and Organization role scope apply; missing actions/facts deny. Provider/security numerical configuration and executable fixtures remain activation qualification.

rulings.title: Versioned source events and reward consumer mapping
rulings.body: Adopt authority-event-contracts.md WA-R069 committed fact registry, registered consumer effects, replay/tombstone/correction semantics and reward source-to-User mappings. Identity owns platform-role facts; no speculative Role stream/cache. Events never grant authority or replace explicit effect commands. Order owns purchase/full-outcome/timeliness, Review owns individual published-rating eligibility, Professional owns completion-policy facts. Rule-lineage/source/User effect identity prevents duplicate rewards across corrections or mirrored events. Numerical program/legal/provider policies and executable qualification remain scoped activation gates.
